leadershipMode.label: Strategic technical leadership
leadershipMode.headline: Principal / Staff Technical Advisor
leadershipMode.summary: Senior enterprise technologist bringing systems-level judgment to cloud infrastructure, reliability, security, and application integration. Experienced in technical leadership, architecture, and cross-team collaboration, with a preference for influential individual-contributor or advisory responsibilities over line management.
leadershipMode.notes: Presentation lens only; it must not rewrite past job titles, inflate managerial scope, or alter employment dates.
